notes.title: Agrou Update 1.7
notes.notes:
Hello, villagers!

It has been so encouraging for us to see so many people sit around the fire and play the game since the last update and price change. For that, we've been working hard on a new update, the 1.7! Here are the main changes at a glance:

[list]
[*] A brand new role: the Ninja!
[*] A new map : the Pirates Islands
[*] New premium skins and pets
[*] Random map mode
[*] Voice detection (or push-to-talk)
[*] Scale resolution for low-end configurations
[*] And more things to discover in the changelog
[/list]

Let's start with the new role, [b]the Ninja[/b]! This character wins alone (blue card) and you will have to be very cautious and discreet to prevail. During the day, you can throw discreetly a shuriken to poison a player. This player will die the next morning if nobody spotted you and if you stay alive until then. Wait for the right moment and keep your composure!

Also check out the new map, [b]the Pirates Islands[/b]! This desert island still has traces of the past pirate battles, and some even tell that this place hide some secrets and treasures... what are you waiting for to explore?

Some new premium [b]cosmetic content[/b] have arrived in the shop: pirates, native americans, tigers, red pandas... there even are some skins of the developers of Agrou, apparently!

[b]Thanks[/b] again for your support since the last update of Agrou!

If you discover some new bugs, please let us know on [url=https://suggestions.agrou.fr]https://suggestions.agrou.fr[/url]. Our developers tested this new update again and again and are now ready to fix anything that might come up!

Here is the changelog of the 1.7 update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/b8ca3fad1b216bd93ea35769d6b5781a3932587f.png[/img]

- New role: the Ninja
- New map: the Pirates Islands
- Random map mode: at the end of every game, the map changes randomly

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/5d7293910140cb13b98a609384b767150e355b44.png[/img]

- New setting: scale resolution. It helps low-end configurations tremendously!
- You can now chose between voice detection and push-to-talk
- 10 premium skins (and 10 matching graves)
- 4 pets

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/d9622e0f01c30c31af5f3a582ac6415571605d78.png[/img]

- The Pyromaniac, when he is asleep, can no longer use his ability

Thank you all, and have fun! [b]Don't trust your neighbors![/b]

notes.title: Agrou Update 1.6
notes.notes:
Hello, villagers!

This is a big update, welcome to Agrou 1.6! Here are the main changes at a glance:

[list]
[*] A brand new role: the Blaster!
[*] 3rd person view and new animations
[*] Lower price (from $11.99 to $4.99) as of 05/16 10am (PT time)
[*] Premium skins
[*] Pets!
[*] And more things to discover in the changelog
[/list]

Let's start with [b]the new role[/b]! We really like roles that sow discord in the village: the Anesthetist, the Assassin, the Dictator, the Hunter... we always had a lot of fun watching you play those! You are now going to experience the [b]Blaster[/b], the king of troublemakers (ally of the village)! At night he can throw a bomb at a player and he is the only one who knows how many turns it will take before it explodes the next day. When the sun rises, villagers throw the bomb at each other until someone unlucky blows up! If the bomb explodes in the hands of a village's enemy, the Blaster will get a new bomb. We hope you have nerves of steel!

Big news, [b]Agrou's price is going to be lowered drastically[/b] to $4.99 as of 05/16 10am (CET time)! This price change will first be in the form of a 60% discount, then after the end of this discount the price will stay at $4.99 indefinitely! With this major change, we hope that it will be easier for you to invite your friends to the game and live this thrilling experience with more players! All of the updates up until today have only been possible thanks to the massive support of our community, so [b]every person that played Agrou before today will get a gift[/b] when they launch the 1.6 version!

This price drop goes along with [b]many new cosmetics elements[/b]: complete skins with matching thematic graves, and [b]brand new pets[/b]! These cute and loyal animals will follow you on all maps and seat beside you during the games! There are currently 20 skins and 20 graves (launch the game regularly to discover the skins of the day!) and 10 pets. This content is only cosmetic and have been added to let you customize even more your experience on Agrou. It will support the updates and servers costs and help us maintain the game.

[b]Thanks[/b] again for your support since the beginning of this adventure on Agrou, we can't wait to see you fly everywhere because of the crazy Blaster!

If you discover some new bugs, please let us know on [url=https://suggestions.agrou.fr]https://suggestions.agrou.fr[/url]. Our developers tested this new update again and again and are now ready to fix anything that might come up!

Here is the changelog of the 1.6 update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/b8ca3fad1b216bd93ea35769d6b5781a3932587f.png[/img]

- New role: the Blaster
- You can now check who voted for the player who was killed (many of you didn't like "ninja" votes!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/5d7293910140cb13b98a609384b767150e355b44.png[/img]

- New third person view: you can now see your wonderful skins! Between the games you can switch between 1st and 3rd person view (X key by default)
- Something has been hidden on every map... this is going to be a mess...
- New jump animation
- 20 premium skins (and 20 matching graves)
- 10 pets (including some shiny variants)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/d9622e0f01c30c31af5f3a582ac6415571605d78.png[/img]

- Some scenery elements where you could get stuck have been fixed
- You can no longer go out of bound in the Cavern of Belfalas

Thank you all, and have fun! [b]Don't trust your neighbors![/b]

notes.title: Agrou Update 1.5
notes.notes:
Hello, villagers!

We have been working on a stability and quality of life update this time! Agrou needed some tweaks to live up to your expectations: 

[list]
[*] Better microphone handling
[*] Better microphone quality
[*] Ban feature
[*] Emotes wheel
[*] FPS boost (+40 fps in our tests)
[/list]

This one took us a long time as we also updated the game to Unreal Engine 4.25 and needed to check that everything still worked as intended. Thanks to this big update we have been able to improve Agrou's voice system, and [b]we are also revamping the whole matchmaking system as we speak[/b]. We are nearly done with this and you will soon be able to play with your friends in other regions without any issue!

Here is the changelog of the 1.5 update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/b8ca3fad1b216bd93ea35769d6b5781a3932587f.png[/img]

- You now have access to 14 emotes/reactions in-game (open the emote wheel with the R key by default on a fresh install, or the P key on an existing install)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/5d7293910140cb13b98a609384b767150e355b44.png[/img]
- Increased voice quality
- You can now chose your microphone in settings (and change its volume/gain)
- Ban feature! When hosting a game, you can now ban undesirable players. Those players won't be able to join your games. You can unban a player in the settings menu
- When hosting a game, you can now kick/ban/mute a player directly from the TAB menu
- Agrou is now compatible with computers without GPU (thanks for your feedback!)
- Various improvements to greatly boost FPS!

Thank you all, and have fun! [b]Don't trust your neighbors![/b]

notes.title: Agrou Update 1.4
notes.notes:
Hello, villagers!

What's that burning smell? [b]The 1.4 update is here today and brings a new role: the Pyromaniac![/b]

Featuring:
[list]
[*] A new role : the Pyromaniac
[*] In-game shops on all maps
[*] Neutral vote by clicking on the campfire
[*] You can now save or load custom decks
[/list]

Let's talk about this new role: the [b]Pyromaniac[/b] (blue card)! Once again, a very dangerous role which is going to spice up your games! Every night he can soak up to two players in oil. The next morning, those two players will have the bad surprise to be soaked and a bit smelly! Then the Pyromaniac can keep soaking up players or he can immolate all the soaked up players. Up to six players can be burnt at the same time by Pyromaniac, there will be trouble!

We also added new zones on every map: full-scale shops with salesmen so you can switch gear between games! Seeing so many naked players was heartbreaking and we now hope that everybody will think about spending their money and going shopping!

You can now have a neutral vote during the day! To do this, you just have to click on the campfire in the center instead of a player. Way more handy to skip a day or bluff!

Lastly, you can now save or load your own custom decks in the game creation menu. This a very handy feature that will avoid you adding every card manually everytime you create or modify a game, we hope you will like it! 

We are now going to work on big things to make Agrou a better game: a better matchmaking system, and a better handling of microphones. And of course, we are going to work once again on a brand new role! Good luck to our developers!


Here is the changelog of the 1.4 update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/b8ca3fad1b216bd93ea35769d6b5781a3932587f.png[/img]

- A new role was added: the Pyromaniac
- Salesmen are now on all maps and allow you to change your gear in-game
- Cupid now wins with the players in love, even if he dies during the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/5d7293910140cb13b98a609384b767150e355b44.png[/img]

- You can now save or load custom decks when you create or modify a game
- The recap menu (TAB and at the end of the game) now displays days and what happened during them
- You can now change the map without leaving the server
- The Tamer role has been totally revamped and should now be more stable
- The randomization algorithm has been improved
- When no gamemode is active and the Witch poisons someone, a potion is now thrown at the victim
- The sneezing sound of asleep players is less loud
- The White Wolf card has been updated to clarify the fact that he can kill anybody, not just Wolves
- The codex has been reorganized
- Many new colors for clothes
- End of the Halloween event! You can still use customized graves but the main menu is back to normal
- The game credits have been updated
- Some Vietnamese translations have been improved


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/d9622e0f01c30c31af5f3a582ac6415571605d78.png[/img]

- We fixed a bug where the Anaesthetist had a villager appearance (only for himself) when he voted at night
- It is no longer possible to get stuck in trees when flying
- When a Hunter or a Dictator dies during the day as he is asleep, the anaesthesia effect is now removed as intended when he dies
- A bug has been fixed in the shop : when you chose a grave and then customized your character, the camera did not move back to the character location


Thank you all, and have fun! [b]Don't trust your neighbors![/b]

notes.title: Agrou Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Hello, villagers!

[b]The 1.3 update is coming today and brings tons of new content![/b]

Featuring:
[list]
[*] A brand new role : the Anesthetist Wolf
[*] Two gamemodes (combinable!) : hide dead people's roles / hidden deck
[*] Halloween content: a new map, customize : a new map, customized graves, a new main menu
[/list]


So, a brand new role appears: [b]the Anesthetist [/b] (red card)! It is the second new Wolf role of Agrou with the Misty Wolf and it is absolutely formidable. Every night, he can play his wolf turn normally and vote with other wolves to decide which villager will be devoured. But from the second night, he can anesthetize a player! This villager, asleep, won't be able to move, speak, write or even vote on the next day, which will be convenient for the wolves...

We are also very happy to let you customize your graves! Halloween seemed like an ideal moment for this, you can now die with class! You will also be able to play on a new spooky map: the Helendor Cemetery.

Last but not least, Agrou now features two gamemodes many of you asked for. The first one hides dead people's roles, whereas the second one hides the deck of the game (even the host can't see the roles and the deck is randomized). These two gamemodes are combinable by the way! This should help you bluff even more in your games.

Here is the changelog of the 1.3 update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/b8ca3fad1b216bd93ea35769d6b5781a3932587f.png[/img]

- A new role was added: the Anesthetist
- New gamemode: hide dead people's roles
- New gamemode: hidden deck (3 roles can be banned by the host)
- Customized graves (available in the shop)
- You can now crouch!
- New skin colors
- New hair colors

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/5d7293910140cb13b98a609384b767150e355b44.png[/img]

- WASD key setup by default for English speaking players
- The transition time between day and night when nobody dies has been shortened
- The deck randomization algorithm has been enhanced
- You can now create a random deck during a game
- People alive are now displayed in the final recap, with their role (if the gamemode without dead people's roles is not enabled)
- The TAB menu is more ergonomic
- The server's name and the gamemodes are now displayed in the TAB menu
- New mouse cursor
- A little surprise when you score on Angmar Plains
- An option to enable motion blur has been added in Settings

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/d9622e0f01c30c31af5f3a582ac6415571605d78.png[/img]

- The "do nothing" action of the Crow won't appear at the end of his turn if there is latency
- If the person killed by the Dictator is Wolve and leaves the game instantly after his death, the Dictator won't kill himself
- When a Werewolf dies at the same time as the Black Wolf converts someone, the Werewolf card doesn't duplicate anymore
- The TAB menu feed no longer disappears for the converted players
- The Influencer will get his gold and experience when he completes his mission but gets converted
- Some Turkish translations have been enhanced
- The firework sound effect is now correctly classified in the "Effects" category


Thank you all, and have fun! [b]Don't trust your neighbors![/b]

notes.title: Agrou Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello, villagers!

[b]Welcome to the first content update of Agrou: the 1.2 update ![/b]

You can now play a brand-new role which was asked many times by the community: [b]the Assassin[/b]! Every night, he can assassinate any player and he must be the last player standing to win (blue card). Wolves can't kill him, but they know he is the Assassin! It is a powerful role but you will have to be very clever to win!

[b]To our Vietnamese and Turkish communities: we added translations of Agrou in your language! Thank you so much for your enthusiasm and patience.[/b]

Once again, there are also gameplay adjustment, bugs fixes, quality of life improvements.

We are already working on adding another role and additional gameplay features. Definitely great things to come!

We heard your feedback, and we are also working on adding a new gamemode where roles in the game will be hidden. At the moment we don't want to hide players' role when they die as it doesn't fit with our fun vision of the werewolf game. We will keep listening to your suggestions and we prefer not to rush those gameplay choices, so we don't make mistakes :)

Here is the changelog of the 1.2 update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/b8ca3fad1b216bd93ea35769d6b5781a3932587f.png[/img]

- A new role was added: the Assassin!
- The Medium can now use his skill one in two turn
- Cupid and the Crow can now choose not to do anything during their turn

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/7c8d9a129b6b6cb65fc1e09c96da771b45c7ef7f.png[/img]

- New translations: Vietnamese and Turkish
- Global graphic optimization (average gain of 26% on all maps, up to 31% on some maps)
- New ranking list in the TAB menu (based on the amount of gold earned during the games)
- An hanging animation has been added in case of draw in votes
- Ragdolls behavior has been improved (they still fly in random ways, don't worry!)
- There is now a celebration when the Influencer completes his mission, so everyone understands that someone was acting out of self-interest
- When only one person hasn't voted (mayor election, village vote), the timer is now reduced
- The end screen is now colored according to the winning team 
- Nicknames of players who leave the game are now displayed
- In the servers list the ongoing games now display "In Progress" instead of the player count
- Embassies have been added in the map Helendor Village
- Pants levels have been adjusted from levels 30 to 50
- The logo displayed when the Witch saves someone has been modified
- The coin icon has been modified

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/d9622e0f01c30c31af5f3a582ac6415571605d78.png[/img]

- The Necromancer can't speak with dead players during the day anymore
- The Little Girl can't see the whole screen anymore during a split second at the end of the Werewolves' turn
- It is no longer possible for a player to join an ongoing game and be able to move around
- The card explaining the role of the Mayor now displays correctly in every language when hovering the role icon
- The red nickname of a converted Werewolf is now red even in case of latency
- Accents now display correctly in servers list
- Messages are no longer cut in the text chat
- Korean strings have been fixed

Thank you all, and have fun! [b]Don't trust your neighbors![/b]

notes.title: Agrou Update 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Hello, villagers!

[b]We've got a great update for you today: 1.1.4![/b]

To our Korean community: we have added a Korean translation to the game! We hope your experience will be even better now :) Many more translations will follow thanks to your hard work on [url=https://poeditor.com/join/project/n0amwmXNHU]our translation platform[/url]!

Once again, you sent us a lot of bug reports and suggestions, thank you so much! There is now a dedicated website for it: [url=https//suggestions.agrou.fr]https//suggestions.agrou.fr[/url]

Here is the 1.1.4 changelog since 1.1:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/b8ca3fad1b216bd93ea35769d6b5781a3932587f.png[/img]

- The Little Girl's field of vision has been greatly narrowed again, it is now a lot harder to identify Wolves without being spotted by the most attentive ones
- The Hunter can't shoot anymore when he kills himself out of love
- When Cupid shoots on only one player, he is now automatically linked to this person (there can't be only one lover anymore)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/7c8d9a129b6b6cb65fc1e09c96da771b45c7ef7f.png[/img]

- Korean translation was added
- When two people are targeted by the Wolves', the Witch now knows the identity of those two players
- The message telling the Wolves' target for the Witch now displays during her whole turn or until she takes a decision 
- The text chat has been entirely reworked to be more intuitive
- The role distribution algorithm has been tweaked so it less frequent to get the same role in multiple games in a row
- The game's sound is no longer muted when the game is minimized
- In the deck modification menu during a game, the previous deck is now saved so you don't have to re-add every role manually
- In games with many players, cards are not displayed out of the screen anymore
- Your nickname, title and gold are now displayed in the TAB menu
- The whole game was optimized, some setups can gain up to 20 FPS
- The main menu and night's songs have been changed (the previous ones could cause warnings on YouTube)
- Only the Wolve' chat resets at the end of the night (lovers can keep writing without sending their message in villagers' chat)
- When no key is assigned in controls, the "None" text is now in red
- A kick sound is now played when you shoot the soccer ball
- The soccer ball's color is now lighter so you can find it easier
- The "Customization" button's color was modified so you don't forget to dress!
- Customization categories are now sorted more logically
- Dead players flied too often by accident, you now have to press space faster to fly
- Seats' positions have been fixed
- The Necromancer's chat now opens with T, avoiding a conflict with the lovers' chat when he is a lover himself
- Private servers' passwords can now be typed directly (without using your mouse)
- For clarity, there now are flags next to languages in the server creation menu
- The volume of the sound played when the Angel wins has been reduced
- A jump parkour has been added in Cavern of Belfalas, can you go to the hanging beam?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/d9622e0f01c30c31af5f3a582ac6415571605d78.png[/img]

- The Tamer's dog had several issues and now behaves as intended
- The Hunter can't shoot into space anymore
- The Hunter can now shoots as intended if he dies the same night as the mayor
- It is no longer possible for the Black Wolf to infect himself or a Wolve
- When the mayor leaves the game, dead players can't be elected instead
- When a player's lover get poisoned by the Witch, this player can't be protected by the Guard anymore
- The fireplace now respawns normally when the Angel wins by a draw in votes
- In the deck's modification menu, latency doesn't allow to add special roles twice anymore
- Nicknames can't be seen as "None" anymore
- The main menu can't be displayed during the loading of a game anymore
- Turns' timers are now correct for every turns
- The "Start the game" button can't be displayed during a game anymore for the host
- The server creation menu now displays as intended on 16:10 monitors
- The end screen can't be stuck anymore
- A spot where you could be stuck in Helendor Village has been fixed
- The mouse isn't automatically free anymore when you send a message with the Enter key
- The "Clutch player" success now works
- It is no longer possible to be stucked without the main menu displayed when the game launches

Thank you all, and have fun! [b]Don't trust your neighbours![/b]

notes.title: Agrou Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello, villagers !

[b]The very first Agrou's update, 1.1, is here![/b]

Many of you sent us bug reports and suggestions on [url=https://discord.com/invite/wZGcz2P]the official Discord[/url]. Thanks to you and our developers, today we have a really great changelog! This first update focuses on the game's stability (bugs, improvements on existing features, gameplay adjustments). We want the game to be stable and like we want before adding new content to Agrou : new roles, new features... we have really fun ideas for the future that we think you will like!

We've been really surprised to see streams on Agrou everywhere in the world since launch: France, Korea, Turkey, Brazil... many thanks to all streamers who tried Agrou with their friends! We laughed a lot watching you guys and we are honored :) By the way, if you want to participate in Agrou's translation in all languages, you can do it [url=https://poeditor.com/join/project/n0amwmXNHU]on this platform[/url]. Some translations are nearly finished thanks to some contributors, and we are already working on adding those languages to the game!

Without further delay, here is the changelog of the 1.1 version of Agrou:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/b8ca3fad1b216bd93ea35769d6b5781a3932587f.png[/img]

- The Hunter can now shoot however he dies
- The Little Girl's field of vision has been greatly narrowed
- When someone is infected by the Black Wolf, its card doesn't disappear anymore (but a Wolf card is added)
- The White Wolf can now kill anybody at night, not only the Wolves
- When the Hunter is in the last two players, dies and shoots the last player, the end result is a draw
- Dead players can only talk to dead players in vocal chat, and listen to the living players
- When a lover has to kill himself out of love, he dies even if he was protected by the Guard
- The White Wolf now has access to the Wolves' chat

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/7c8d9a129b6b6cb65fc1e09c96da771b45c7ef7f.png[/img]

- Numerous graphic optimizations on all maps
- A kissing sound is played for the lovers when they fall in love
- A message is now displayed on screen for the lovers when they fall in love
- A half-heart icon is now displayed on lover's cards, above their role
- It is now mentioned that lovers must win together
- By default, all servers are now displayed in the servers list
- Optimizations for 21:9 screens
- After typing a private server's password, you can confirm by pressing Enter. Handy!
- When you join a private server, the Join button is now on the right, and the Cancel button on the left
- The key to display FPS can now be modified in keyboard settings
- When the day phase begins, if Wolves are typing in the Wolves' chat, their message is now automatically cleared so they don't send it in the general chat
- The end screen now displays faster at the end of games
- Vocal chat volume has been increased
- Goalposts' texture has been modified in Angmar Plains
- The message displayed when the Dictator starts a coup d'état is now translated in English
- Tamer and Influencer cards were modified to add clarifications
- Angmar Plains' soccer ball has been moved and should be found more easily
- All chimneys in Helendor Village are now hollow
- A switching weapon sound is now played when the Hunter draws his rifle
- When the Hunter dies, his lover now has a death camera

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639185/d9622e0f01c30c31af5f3a582ac6415571605d78.png[/img]

- When the Angel dies in the first turn with a draw in votes, the camera doesn't stay stucked on the ground anymore when he flies away
- You now get explanations displayed when you mouse over the Tamer's card
- Games now go on when there are only Wolves and a White Wolf left
- When lauching the game from a desktop shortcut, your nickname won't be your computer's name anymore
- You can no longer get stucked in Angmar Plains' trees
- You can no longer get stucked in Cavern of Belfalas' stalagmites
- When the Black Wolf is poisoned by the Witch, his target is converted and no longer killed
- It is no longer possible to see someone without nickname
- The Guard can't see the visual effect of lovers linked by Cupid anymore
- When a player gets infected, he now sees other wolves' nicknames in red
- Steps sound effects can now be heard in Helendor Village
- It is no longer possible to shoot twice as Dictator
- When the Angel gets infected, he can't win as Angel anymore
- When you modify the game you can no longer add a special role twice
- When you chose ears in the shop hats are no longer removed
- The Witch can no longer spot an infected player with his vote number
- The Black Wolf's turn will no longer be skipped when he should be able to play
- In some cases death cameras were too long, they now have a normal duration
- Level 14 tattoo now applies normally on female characters
- Hats are now removed normally when you leave the shop with the return button after you choose a haircut
- When the Crow choses a player who is going to die during the night, the two votes of this player are no longer counted during the next day
- When the Hunter is chosen in a draw of votes, he now has his rifle in his hands as intended when he goes back on his seat
- When the Dictator starts a coup d'état in a night where the Hunter gets killed, there is no longer a conflict between their actions
- When lovers are Villager and Wolf, the end screens now displays a victory for lovers
- It is no longer possible to talk to Wolves during the day by clicking on text chat icon
- The Angel can no longer win during the second turn if nobody voted during the first turn
- When the Dictator gets infected, he can't shoot in the morning and becomes Werewolve as intended

Thank you all, and have fun! [b]Don't trust your neighbours![/b]
